name: Hazelwood Millworks Custom Carpentry & Woodworking
old_description: Looking to renovate your kitchen, bathroom, or another room? Hazelwood Millworks proudly specializes in custom cabinetry. Choose from Oak, Walnut, Ash, Maple, Cherry, and more to create a stunning statement piece. Cabinets alone can significantly elevate an outdated kitchen, providing not only a beautiful environment but also increased home value.
about:
Hazelwood Millworks operates from Hilliard, Ohio, serving the greater Columbus metropolitan area. The company specializes in custom carpentry and woodworking for residential and commercial clients.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, furniture, and architectural millwork using domestic hardwoods such as oak, walnut, ash, maple, and cherry. Services span design, fabrication, and installation, including hand-carved ornamental details and matching of existing moldings. The company also handles commercial and government projects, delivering built-in features like staircases, moldings, columns, and wainscoting.

Clients range from homeowners and interior designers to architects, general contractors, and public institutions. Past projects include courtrooms, churches, schools, and small businesses throughout central Ohio. The firm frequently partners with design professionals to supply luxury cabinetry and millwork for collaborative projects.

Hazelwood Millworks emphasizes sustainably sourced lumber, often using previously fallen trees or reclaimed wood, and positions its work as a way to support local industry and Ohio’s natural habitat. The company states that its ethically sourced materials and handmade craftsmanship result in pieces built to last for generations.
